inclusion_rule: Only brands that have customers, business or consumer, are included. Companies that Wikidata records as dissolved have no current customers and are left out.
full_category_description: every Wikidata item whose products include handbags or leather goods, or whose industry is leather goods, and that has an English Wikipedia article
intro: When customers ask AI about a {product} brand or the category, it can lean heavily on Wikipedia and Wikidata. BrandTabulator measures how fully and recently each brand is described on those sites, and how often it is read by people and machines. BrandTabulator refreshes every week, so bookmark this tab.

Of course, there are many sources that AI relies on. My work is to Diagnose the responses, Investigate the sources they credit, and Prescribe what can be done to improve the visibility and accuracy of a brand's descriptions in AI (DIP). I'm available for workshops, speaking engagements and consultations for brands in AI. Contact Michael@MichaelQuinn.ai
